closed: Game closed · ready for next launch
configError: Configuration error · last valid settings retained
selectGame: Select the Corsair Cove game folder.
closeGame: Close Corsair Cove to set up or update the trainer, then retry.
unsupported: This game build is not supported. No game files were changed.
loaderConflict: An incompatible loader or UE4SS version is already installed. No files were changed.
helpBody: Enable the options you want, adjust the factors and click Apply. Settings persist after closing the trainer. Reset all disables every option. Hover over an option or status dot for details. The game must be restarted after a trainer update. Languages can be changed here at any time.
walkTip: Speeds up carrier simulation and walking together. Unlock bonuses still apply.
shipsTip: Changes sailing and travel speed, including NPC ships.
constructionTip: Speeds up building progress. Materials and workers are still required.
rangeTip: Changes building and logistics range for new and existing camps (×1–500). Range bonuses remain. Use the separate coastal option to limit attack points.
routesTip: Raises carrier route limits to at least 999. Assign extra routes in game. Cargo and storage stay unchanged.
overlapTip: Allows pirate camps inside another camp’s range. Other building conditions still apply.
coastTip: Assigns the nearest existing coastal attack point to each camp. Several camps may share one point.
fogTip: Keeps discovered Caribbean regions visible. Does not reveal unexplored regions.
battleTip: Separate protection from life, crew and supply losses during Caribbean dice encounters.
invalidRegistry: The mod registry is invalid. Repair mods.json before retrying.
elevation: Windows permission is required to update files in the game folder.
installMissing: The embedded setup files are missing or damaged.
housingTip: Multiplies housing supplied by each pirate camp (×1–100). Extra houses keep their normal capacity. Example: 25 camp beds ×10 = 250, plus houses. Uses the current game capacity, including existing bonuses; fractions round down. Food and other needs still apply. Off restores normal capacity.
warehouseTip: Room for 6 or 9 goods types with five slots each and a wider warehouse panel. Trading posts stay unchanged. Reducing the limit retains goods and allocations; free excess slots in the warehouse before disabling.
bridgesTip: Multiplies maximum bridge length (×1–10). Slope, terrain and material requirements still apply. Off restores the original length limit.
